verdict.rationale: A backend platform like Convex could plausibly ship a built-in assistant (for example in its dashboard), so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows support for external coding agents: an MCP server, setup prompts and agent-friendly docs. It also shows vector search as a building block for AI apps, and none of this is a built-in AI assistant that users delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
